title: Get someone to do, have something done
summary: Nhờ, khiến người khác làm: have sb do, get sb to do; nhờ làm cho mình: have/get sth done; và make/let ở bị động.

dialogue.vi: Cảm ơn. Hôm qua mình đi cắt.

dialogue.en: I [[got my brother to fix]] it. He's good with computers.
dialogue.vi: Mình nhờ anh trai sửa. Anh ấy rành máy tính.

dialogue.en: Lucky you. My boss [[had me work]] late again.
dialogue.vi: Sướng thế. Sếp lại bắt mình làm muộn.

dialogue.en: Again? You [[were made to]] stay late last week too.
dialogue.vi: Lại nữa à? Tuần trước bạn cũng bị bắt ở lại muộn.

sections.heading: Have sb do / get sb to do
sections.rule: **have + sb + V** và **get + sb + to V** = nhờ, bảo ai làm gì. **Get** thường hàm ý phải thuyết phục.

examples.en: I'll [[have the waiter bring]] the bill.
examples.vi: Tôi sẽ bảo bồi bàn mang hóa đơn.

examples.en: She [[got her son to clean]] his room.
examples.vi: Cô ấy bắt được con trai dọn phòng.
examples.why: Get + sb + to V: phải thuyết phục.

check.prompt: I got my friend ___ me move house.

sections.heading: Have / get something done
sections.rule: **have / get + vật + V3** = nhờ người khác làm việc đó cho mình (cắt tóc, sửa xe…). Cũng dùng cho việc **không mong muốn**: *I had my phone stolen*.

examples.vi: Chúng tôi thuê người sơn nhà.

examples.en: I need to [[get my eyes tested]].
examples.vi: Tôi cần đi kiểm tra mắt.
Anh ấy bị mất trộm xe đạp.

check.prompt: I'm going to have my car ___ tomorrow.

sections.heading: Be made to do, be allowed to do
sections.rule: Chủ động **make sb do** (không to) → bị động **be made to do** (có to). **Let** không dùng bị động → **be allowed to**.

examples.vi: Chúng tôi bị bắt mặc đồng phục.
examples.why: Bị động của make: be made to V.

examples.en: She [[was allowed to]] go home early.
examples.vi: Cô ấy được phép về sớm.
examples.why: Bị động của let: be allowed to.

check.prompt: The children were made ___ their homework again.

mistakes.wrong: She got her brother fix the car.
mistakes.right: She got her brother to fix the car.

mistakes.wrong: I'll have him to call you.
He was made clean the room.
mistakes.right: He was made to clean the room.
mistakes.why: Bị động: be made to V.

mistakes.wrong: We were let to leave early.
mistakes.right: We were allowed to leave early.

exercises.prompt: I had the mechanic ___ the tires.
Where did you get your dress ___?
My parents got me ___ the dishes.
He was made ___ for an hour.
Câu nào nghĩa là người khác cắt tóc cho cô ấy?
exercises.explain: Have + vật + V3: nhờ người làm.

exercises.prompt: I need to get my phone ___.
The teacher had us ___ the poem.
We weren't ___ to use our phones in class.
exercises.explain: Bị động của let → be allowed to.

exercises.prompt: She got the shop ___ her money back.

exercises.vi: Tôi đi cắt tóc hôm qua.
Tôi nhờ bạn sửa máy tính.

exercises.sentence: We had our roof repair last month.
answers: We had our roof repaired last month.

exercises.sentence: She had her son to carry the bags.
answers: She had her son carry the bags.

exercises.sentence: I was made work on Sunday.
answers: I was made to work on Sunday.

exercises.vi: Chúng tôi thuê người sơn lại phòng khách.
answers: We had the living room painted.
We had our living room painted.
We got the living room painted.
We got our living room painted.
We had the living room repainted.
We had our living room repainted.

exercises.vi: Tôi bị bắt đợi hai tiếng.
answers: I was made to wait for two hours.
I was made to wait two hours.
They made me wait for two hours.
They made me wait two hours.
I was forced to wait for two hours.
